conclusion: No legitimate public dense signed Japanese LD matrix or presently accessible genotype-derived route closes the original BBJ COPD sample/variant contract. Controlled-access BBJ data are a viable future request route; a Japanese reference can only be separately justified as external sensitivity after access. 1000 Genomes EAS was not substituted; r-squared was not converted into signed r.
